# Quickway Auctioneers & Court Bailiffs

> Auctioneers and court bailiffs in Kampala, Uganda. We sell land, houses,
> commercial buildings, vehicles and machinery from court-ordered, bank and
> private sales. Every listing is published on this website with photos,
> location and closing date, and the starting price where one is set.

## What we sell
- Land: agricultural, mailo, freehold and leasehold plots
- Residential property: houses and apartments
- Commercial and industrial property, including operating businesses
- Vehicles, machinery and equipment

## How buying works
- Anyone can view listings without an account.
- To make an offer, create a free account and verify your identity (KYC).
- Offers are sealed: other buyers cannot see them while the auction is open.
- If an auction has a participation fee, it is shown on the listing before you pay.
- When the auction closes, Quickway contacts the successful buyer to complete
  the sale, including deposit, payment and transfer.
- Buyers can book a site visit before making an offer.
